about_the_game:
This demo includes two jam games which will be sections of the game THREE VERSES³. Though they are presented in their original form, we have included a soundtrack player and a short informational section for both sections.

The first section, THREE VERSES, is English-only currently;

The second section, KEYRIN LOVES YOU, has options for English, French, and Spanish.

THREE VERSES³ is a typing-based first-person dungeoncrawler. Finding yourself in purgatory, you must deliver verses from deities to struggling poets.

In this journey, it is essential that you write down key information. You will encounter typing-based RPG battles, word puzzles, and a variety of typing and movement-based minigames across an expansive grid-based world.
